li.label: levy
li.description: A commoner called to arms by their liege, given only basic weapons training before being sent to fight.

li.label: man-at-arms
li.description: A professional soldier who serves a noble House as a guard, warrior, and retainer.

li.label: hedge knight
li.description: A landless knight who travels between Houses, tournaments, and wars in search of employment and coin.

li.label: knight
li.description: A formally trained and anointed warrior skilled in arms, horsemanship, and the customs of chivalry.

li.label: landed knight
li.description: A knight granted a small holding, giving them responsibilities over both warfare and the people living on their land.

li.label: lord / lady
li.description: A member of the nobility raised to govern lands, manage a household, and deal with the politics of other Houses.

li.label: septon / septa
li.description: A devoted servant of the Faith of the Seven who provides religious guidance, education, and basic care for the faithful.

li.label: fanatic
li.description: A fiercely devoted believer whose faith shapes nearly every decision they make and drives them to defend it without hesitation.

li.label: bastard
li.description: Born outside lawful marriage, this pawn carries noble blood but lacks the full rights and standing of a legitimate heir.

li.label: legitimised bastard
li.description: Once born outside lawful marriage, this pawn has been formally recognised as legitimate and may now inherit lands, titles, and the name of their House.
